title: Jump Game II
description:
You stand at position `0` of a list `nums`. From position `i` you may jump forward by any number of steps from `1` up to `nums[i]`.

Return the **smallest number of jumps** needed to reach the last position. Every test can be finished.

### Constraints

- `1 <= nums.size() <= 5000`
- `0 <= nums[i] <= 1000`
- The last position is always reachable.
- Inputs are passed as function arguments and the answer is returned from the function. Do not read from standard input or print the result.

examples.explanation: Jump 1 step from position 0 to position 1, then 3 steps from position 1 to the last position. One jump is not enough, because position 0 can reach at most position 2.
Jump from position 0 to position 1, then from position 1 straight to the end. Landing on position 2 would be a dead end, since its value is 0.
